maddeler.e:
أتفرنس (form IIq)
# أَتَفَرْنَسُ (ʔatafarnasu) /ʔa.ta.far.na.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَفَرْنَسَ (tafarnasa)
# أَتَفَرْنَسَ (ʔatafarnasa) /ʔa.ta.far.na.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَفَرْنَسَ (tafarnasa)
# أَتَفَرْنَسْ (ʔatafarnas) /ʔa.ta.far.nas/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَفَرْنَسَ (tafarnasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
